message.content: The contract requires 1e-6 absolute accuracy over every finite FP16 value, so the full-domain risks are squarely in scope. I'll record the three highest-risk, directly testable claims.

function.arguments: {"statement": "The FP32-rounded multiplier 0.63661977236758134308 (2/pi) used in q = floor(x*(2/pi)+0.5) makes q off-by-one for legal inputs where x*(2/pi)+0.5 is very close to an integer, pushing |r| to ~pi/4 and causing errors above 1e-6 or a sign/quadrant flip.", "rationale": "In Triton the FP64 literal is rounded to FP32; near quadrant boundaries the rounded product can fall on the wrong side of the floor, and at |r| near pi/4 the truncated polynomials are least accurate, so error can exceed 1e-6 even for moderate |x|.", "scope": "in_scope", "scope_rationale": "problem.txt states the 1e-6 bound must hold throughout the entire legal finite FP16 domain, with no permitted range-reduction scheme exempt from it.", "scope_evidence": [{"source": "problem.txt", "summary": "No particular range reduction is part of the target; any scheme is permitted only if the fixed 1e-6 absolute tolerance holds throughout the entire legal domain."}]}

function.arguments: {"statement": "The degree-8 cosine polynomial (cosine = 1 + z*cos_poly with terms up to z^3, i.e. truncated before the r^8/z^4 term) exceeds 1e-6 absolute error near |r| close to pi/4, so odd-quadrant legal inputs (sine near +/-1) produce outputs violating the 1e-6 bound even at moderate |x|.", "rationale": "The cosine polynomial stops at the 1/720 term (effective degree 6 in r), while the sine branch carries an extra 1/362880 term; cos(pi/4)~0.707 with a truncated degree-6 expansion has truncation error of order (pi/4)^8/8! ~ 1.4e-4/40320 before considering minimax fitting, likely above 1e-6 near the interval edge.", "scope": "in_scope", "scope_rationale": "problem.txt fixes the 1e-6 absolute tolerance per element across all legal inputs; any legal odd-quadrant value (ubiquitous in the domain, e.g. near x=pi/2) exercises the cosine branch.", "scope_evidence": [{"source": "problem.txt", "summary": "Every output element must satisfy abs(actual[i] - sin(x[i])) <= 1e-6 for all legal finite FP16 inputs; correctness is a single verdict over the whole domain."}]}
